children: Target named Mark Weinstein as its chief marketing and guest experience officer, effective immediately.
Weinstein joins from Hilton, where he has served as chief marketing officer and head of luxury brands for the hotel chain.

At Target, Weinstein will be tasked with creating a consistent experience across all the ways people engage with the Target brand, including in store and online. He will also oversee the company's curated marketplace Target+ and its retail media network Roundel.
Weinstein will report to Chief Executive Michael Fiddelke.

His appointment comes after Target underwent a leadership shakeup in February, which coincided with the cutting of 500 employees. As part of the shakeup, Lisa Roath, who had previously served as chief marketing officer, was promoted to operating chief.

At the same time, Target's chief commercial officer and head of merchandising for apparel and accessories both departed. The company said at the time that it was conducting an external search for a marketing chief.
"As we continue writing the next chapter at Target, deepening how we know and engage our guests will be critical to our success," Fiddelke said Monday.
